{
  "candidate_rtl": "module mux_large (
    input [7:0] block_a, block_b, block_c, block_d, block_e,
    input [7:0] block_f, block_g, block_h, block_i, block_j,
    input [3:0] sel,
    output reg [7:0] block_out
);
    wire hi_00, hi_01, hi_10;
    wire lo_00, lo_01, lo_10, lo_11;
    wire use_default;

    assign hi_00 = ~sel[3] & ~sel[2];
    assign hi_01 = ~sel[3] &  sel[2];
    assign hi_10 =  sel[3] & ~sel[2];

    assign lo_00 = ~sel[1] & ~sel[0];
    assign lo_01 = ~sel[1] &  sel[0];
    assign lo_10 =  sel[1] & ~sel[0];
    assign lo_11 =  sel[1] &  sel[0];

    assign use_default = sel[3] & (sel[2] | sel[1]);

    always @(*) begin
        block_out =
            (block_a & {8{hi_00}} & {8{lo_00}}) |
            (block_b & {8{hi_00}} & {8{lo_01}}) |
            (block_c & {8{hi_00}} & {8{lo_10}}) |
            (block_d & {8{hi_00}} & {8{lo_11}}) |
            (block_e & {8{hi_01}} & {8{lo_00}}) |
            (block_f & {8{hi_01}} & {8{lo_01}}) |
            (block_g & {8{hi_01}} & {8{lo_10}}) |
            (block_h & {8{hi_01}} & {8{lo_11}}) |
            (block_i & {8{hi_10}} & {8{lo_00}}) |
            (block_j & {8{hi_10}} & {8{lo_01}}) |
            (block_a & {8{use_default}});
    end
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The likely critical path runs from select decoding through data qualification and the wide output reduction. The original default branch can additionally require deriving the complement of the recognized selections.",
  "rewrite": "Use shared two-bit predecodes and parallel masked data terms. Express selections 10 through 15 directly as sel[3] & (sel[2] | sel[1]). Keep the default block_a term separate from its selection-zero term, avoiding an explicit merged block_a enable ahead of data qualification.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Targets a shallower default-selection path and exposes parallel AND/OR logic for compound-cell mapping. No mapped timing results are available, so a numerical gain or improvement over baseline is not established.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "The separate default term increases the reduction from ten data terms to eleven, while shared predecoding limits duplicated decode logic. Mapped area, the 1006.089920 um^2 cap, and zero electrical violations require verification with the specified flow; they are not established here.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves the module name, ports, unsigned widths, and combinational output declaration. Selections 0 through 9 return block_a through block_j respectively; selections 10 through 15 return block_a. Every output bit matches the original for every two-state input. No parameters, storage, latency, assumptions, external dependencies, or new ports are introduced."
}
